notes: The Lime Gen4 (rolled out globally from 2021) is Lime's fourth-generation shared scooter, featuring a swappable ~414-468 Wh battery interchangeable with Lime's Gen4 e-bikes, a more powerful 350 W hill-capable motor, dual hand brakes, and a lower center of gravity for stability. At 27.7 kg it is built heavy for fleet abuse, with a max rider load of 100 kg.

failure_modes.name: Swappable battery latch/interface failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Battery not detected, intermittent power loss over bumps, swap ejection failures in field
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect latch and blade contacts at each swap, clean contacts, replace worn latch assemblies

failure_modes.name: BMS overheat/derate in summer
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced power output, mid-ride shutdowns, thermal fault codes
failure_modes.mitigation: Shade staging areas, firmware thermal limits, rotate packs out of high-cycle duty

failure_modes.name: Brake cable stretch and lever wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Soft lever, longer stopping distance, rider complaints via app
failure_modes.mitigation: Preventive cable adjustment/replacement in maintenance cycles; verify both front and rear systems

failure_modes.name: IoT/GPS unit loss of fix
failure_modes.symptoms: Inaccurate parking verification, ghost vehicles on map, failed geofence speed control
failure_modes.mitigation: Antenna reseat/replacement, firmware updates, flag repeat offenders for board swap

failure_modes.name: Kickstand and stem vandalism damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Bent stems from throwing/tipping, broken kickstands, scooters found in water
failure_modes.mitigation: Structural inspection on retrieval, torque-check folding mechanism, retire water-submerged units' electronics

failure_modes.name: Pneumatic tire puncture
failure_modes.mitigation: Sealant pre-fill, pressure checks at battery swap, transition to puncture-resistant tires
